name: management_seniority_signals
description: A lead role. Exercises Agent 3 rule 12's seniority-aware emphasis — bullets should foreground team scope and outcomes through others, not hands-on depth.
jd_text:
Engineering Manager, Platform

What you'll do:
- Lead a team of 8-12 engineers across two squads
- Own the platform roadmap and delivery commitments
- Grow engineers through coaching and career development
- Partner with senior leadership on technical strategy

Requirements:
- 3+ years managing engineering teams
- Track record shipping platform or infrastructure work
- Strong communication with executive stakeholders

experience.title: Tech Lead
bullets: Led a squad of 6 engineers delivering the internal platform used by every product team
Ran the quarterly planning process and cut missed delivery commitments from 40% to 10%
Coached two engineers to promotion within 18 months
Rebuilt the service scaffolding so a new service took 2 days to stand up instead of 3 weeks
